(αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose for cl. ἐπαινέω, [in LXX chiefly for הלל, ידה;] to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, with dative, τ. Θεῷ. SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω.

τό, [in LXX for גְּוִיָּה,בָּשָׂר, and for Aram. נְבֵלָה;] a body. 1. Prop., of the human body, (a) as always in Hom. (opposite to δέμας), of the dead body: (b) of the living body: ἐν σ. εἶναι, as the instrument of the soul, τὰ διὰ τοῦ σ., opposite to πνεῦμα, to ψυχή, to τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ., σ. ψυχικόν, opposite to σ. πνευματικόν…
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה;] 1. badness in quality (opposite to ἀρετή, excellence). 2. wickedness, depravity, malignity. 3. In late Gk., evil, trouble, affliction. SYN.: (πονηρία)

ἐκ-χέω also Hellenistic, ἐκχύνω (in Th.: 4 *), and ἐκχύννω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַךְ;] to pour out: φιάλην, κέρματα, αἷμα, " (LXX). Pass., αἷμα, οἶνος, σπλάγχνα. Metaphorical, τ. πνεῦμα, (LXX), ἀγάπη, pass., of persons (like Lat. effundor), to give oneself up to (RV, ran riotously in): Ju 11.
indecl. (in FlJ, Ἴσακος, -ου), (Heb. יִצְחָק), Isaac: al

(LTr., θλῖψις), -εως, ἡ (θλίβω), [in LXX for צָרָה,] pressure (Arist.). In LXX and NT metaphorically, tribulation, affliction, distress: with ἀνάγκη, στενοχωρία (which from the order of the words would appear to be the stronger term), διωγμός, θ. ἔχω, ἔρχεσθαι ἐπί, ἐν θλίψει; pl., τ. Χριστοῦ, θ. τῆς καρδίας, θ. ἐγείρειν. SYN.: ἀνάγκη…

interrog. adv., correl. of ὅπως, 1. prop., in direct questions, how?: with indic., καὶ π., π. οὖν, π. οὐ, in deliberative questions, with subjc., π. οὖν, π. δέ, before ἄν, with optative. 2. As sometimes in cl. but more frequently and increasingly so in late writers, = ὅπως, ὥς; (a) in indirect discourse: with indic., with subjc.…
(Rec. Ἐζ-), -ου, ὁ (Heb. חִזְקִיָּה, strength of Jehovah), Hezekiah, King of Judah.

(πρῶτος, τίκτω) [in LXX chiefly for בְּכוֹר;] first-born: pl.. Metaphorical, of the priority of Christ: π. πάσης κτίσεως, ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς, π. (ἐκ) τ. νεκρῶν, pl., of the elect, ἐκκλησία πρωτοτόκων.

ἐκ-ζητέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, also for נָצַר, בָּקַשׁ,] 1. to seek out or after, search for: with accusative of person(s) (1Ma.9:26); figuratively, τ. κύριον, θεόν, εὐλογίαν, ἐξεζήτησαν κ. ἐξηραύνησαν (as in 1Ma.9:26), sought and searched out. 2. As in, (דָּרַשׁ), to demand, require
-ας, ἡ (αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִי, גּוֹלָה;] captivity: pl., abstr. for concr., = αἰχμάλωτοι, (LXX).

genitive -ονος (φρήν), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, נָבָל,] without reason, senseless, foolish, expressing "want of mental sanity and sobriety, a reckless and inconsiderate habit of mind": opposite to φρόνιμος, to συνιέντες.

(ὁράω) [in LXX chiefly for מַרְאֶה, חָזוֹן and cognate forms;] 1. in Arist. and later writers, the act of seeing, the sense of sight, and by meton., pl., the eyes. 2. appearance. 3. = ὅραμα, a vision: (LXX).

[in LXX chiefly for נחם ni., pi.;] 1. to call to one, call for, summon: (R, mg.; R, txt., entreat); hence, to invoke, call on, beseech, entreat: τ. πατέρα μου, τ. κύριον, in late writers, also of men: absol., Phm 9; with accusative, with inf., before ἵνα, Mt 14"36, 2. to admonish, exhort: absol., with accusative, id. before inf.…

ἥτις, ὅ τι, in NT scarcely ever except in nom. (M, Pr., 91), the only instance of the oblique cases being found in ἕως ὅτου, relative of indef. reference (related to simple ὅς as Lat. quisquis to qui), whoever, anyone who; (a) of an indef. person or thing: in general statements, and freq., in relative sentences, πᾶς, with indic.…

genitive, -ους (late, as in π., for cl., -εος Bl., § 8, 4; Mayser, 294), n. p1., ἡμίσια (Rec., cl., -εια), [in LXX for חֵצִי, מַחֲצִית;] half; 1. as adj., agreeing in gender and number with the substantive following, τὰ ἡμίσια τ. ὑταρχόντων. 2. As neut. subst., τὸ ἥμισυ, the half; ἥ. (anarth.), a half: with genitive, ἥ. καιροῦ…

τό (Aram. שַׁבָּתָא, transliterated σάββατα, and this being mistaken for a pl., the sing. σάββατον was formed from it), and σάββατα, -ων, τά [in LXX for שַׁבָּת, שַׁבָּתוֹן;] 1. the seventh day of the week, the sabbath (a) the sing. form -ον, τὸ σ.: ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ σ., ὁδὸς σαββάτου, dative, of time (τῷ) σ., ἐν (τῷ) σ., accusative…

(ὕμνος) [in LXX for הָלַל pi., שִׁיר, יָדָה hi.,] 1. trans., with accusative of person(s) (in cl. also with accusative of thing(s)), to sing to, laud, sing to the praise of. 2. Intrans., to sing: in LXX and NT, of singing hymns and praises to God.
§ Judea, Judean, "land of the Judahites" Judea, the southern party of the country, below Samaria, metonymy the inhabitants of Judea

[in LXX chiefly for פְּרִי;] fruit: of trees, of vines, of fields, βλαστάνειν, ποιεῖν, διδόναι, φέρειν, ἀποδιδόναι, ὁ κ. τ. κοιλίας (בֶּטֶן פְּרִי,), τ. ὀσφύος. Metaphorical, (a) of works, deeds: τ. πνεύματος, τ. φωτός, τ. δικαιοσύνης, σφραγίζεσθαι τὸν κ. (Deiss., BS, 238 f.), κ. ἀγαθοί, (b) of advantage, profit: ἔχειν. συνάγειν, κ. τ…

[in LXX chiefly for יוֹם, also for עֵת,] time: στιγμὴ χρόνου, πλήρωμα τοῦ χ., ποιεῖν χ., βιῶσαι, διδόναι, pl., χ. καὶ (ἢ) καιροί (Lft., l.with), ἐπ᾽ ἐσχάτου τῶν χ. (χρόνου), Ju 18; with prep., ἄχρι, διὰ τὸν χ., ἐν χ., ἐπὶ (πλείονα) χ., ἐφ᾽ ὅσον χ., κατὰ τὸν χ., μετὰ τολὺν (τοσοῦτον) χ., πρὸ χ. αἰωςίων, instr. dative of extension of time…

[in LXX chiefly for זָבַח, also for שָׁחַט,] as in c1.; 1. to offer first fruits to a god. 2. to sacrifice by slaying a victim, offer sacrifice: with dative of person(s), id. with accusative of thing(s). 3. to slay, kill: with accusative of thing(s), pass., τὸ πάσχα, pass..

τό (μείρομαι), [in LXX chiefly for קָצֶה;] 1. a part, share, portion: (Page, in l), hence (cl.), lot, destiny. 2. a part as opposite to the whole: with genitive (of the whole), τ. Φαρισαίων, pl., of the divisions of a province, of the regions belonging to a city, with genitive appos., in adverbial phrases, ἀνὰ (κατὰ) μέρος, μέρος τι…

(συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּינָה and cogn. forms, מַשְׂכִּית, דַּעַת, חׇכְמָה,] 1. a running or flowing together (Hom.). 2. (a) understanding: " (LXX), (b) the understanding, the mind or intelligence. SYN.: see: σοφία
(ἑπτὰ), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִיעִי;] seventh: " (LXX), Ju 14.
[in LXX, β. Κυρίου, frequently for זְרוֹעַ יהוָֹה;] the arm; as in OT, β. Κυρίου, metaphorically, for the Divine power: " (LXX).
(-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν) (χαλκός), [in LXX chiefly for נְחֹשֶׁת;] brazen (i.e. of copper).
ἐπ-άνω adv., [in LXX for מַעֲלָה, עַל, מֵעָל,] above; 1. adverbially; (a) of place: (b) of number, more than. 2. As prep. C. genitive; (a) of place: (b) of pre-eminence.
(prop, fem, of ἕσπερος), [in LXX chiefly for עָרַב;] (a) (sc. ὥρα), evening: (b) (so. χώρα), the west.
τό [in LXX for קוֹמָה, מָרוֹם,] height: of heaven (EV, on high), ἐξ ὕ., εἰς ὕ., (LXX)

[in LXX for חפץ, אבה, יעץ,] to will, wish, desire, purpose, be minded, implying more strongly than θέλω, the deliberate exercise of volition: with inf. (M, Pr., 205; Bl., §69, 4), II, Ju 5; with accusative, with accusative and inf., of the will making choice between alternatives, εἰ βούλει, with subjc.…

(ἔλεος), [in LXX (Hex, Pss, Pr) chiefly for חָנַן, also frequently in Proph. for רָחַם,] to have pity or mercy on, to show mercy: absol., with accusative, Ju 22. Pass., to have pity or mercy shown one (EV, obtain mercy).

[in LXX chiefly for טָמֵא;] 1. to dye or stain. 2. to stain, defile, soil; (a) in physical sense; (b) in moral sense: Ju 8; (with) in ritual sense. SYN.: μολύνω, to besmear, which also differs from μ. in that it is never used, as μ. in its primary meaning, in an honourable sense

τό dimin, of παῖς, [in LXX chiefly for יֶלֶד, also for נַעַר, בֵּן, frequently in To in ref. to full-grown youth;] a young child, a little one: ff., of older children, in pl., ff., Metaphorical. Colloq. in familiar address: Jn Jn SYN.: see: παῖς
συν-τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi.;] to prescribe, ordain, arrange: with dative of person(s), " (LXX).
(pl. not irreg. as in Attic), τό, [in LXX chiefly for קָרַן;] a horn: of the projections at the corners of the altar. Metaphorical, as symbol of strength, κ. σωτηρίας.
τό (βδελύσσω), [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶץ,תּוֹעֵבָה;] an abomination, a detestable thing: τὸ β. τ. ἐρημώσεως, (Cremer, 138).
(Att.. contr. ὀστοῦν, -οῦ, and so Jo, l.with), -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for עֶצֶם;] a bone: contr., ὀστοῦν, (LXX); uncontr. (as in Hom., Hdt.), ὀστέα, ὀστέων.

interrog. adv., [in LXX for אַי, אַיֵּה, אָן;] 1. prop., where?: ποῦ (ἐστιν), indicating that the subject in question is not to be found, ποῦ φανεῖται. 2. = ὅπου (WM, 640; B1., § 50, 5): with indic., with subjc.. 3. In colloq. (as in Eng.) = ποῖ, whither: in direct questions, in indir. quest..
δεικνύω, [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה hi.;] to show, with accusative of thing(s) (of person(s)), dative of person(s); (a) to show, exhibit: " (LXX), pass., (LXX); (b) to make known: (with) to prove.
(δίκη), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול,] 1. unjust. 2. unrighteous, wicked: opposite to δίκαιος, to εὐσεβής, to πιστός, (Cremer, 200).

[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא;] 1. full, filled: with genitive of thing(s), λέπρας, metaphorically, of the soul: πνεύματος ἀγίου, πίστεως, χάριτος, ib.; χ. καὶ ἀληθείας, δόλου, θυμοῦ, ἔργων ἀγαθῶν. 2. full, complete: μισθός, II Jn 8; σῖτος.

[in LXX for חַג (chiefly), מוֹעֵד;] a feast, festival: ἡ ἑ. τοῦ πάσχα, τ. ἀζύμων, ἡ σκηνοπηγία, (Deiss., LAE, 116); ἐν τ. ἑ., (εἶναι ἐν ἑ.), εἰς τ. ἑ. (for the feast), ἀναβαίνειν, ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τ. ἑ., τῆς ἐ μεσούσης, κατὰ ἑ. (at each feast), R, mg.; τ. ἑ. ποιεῖν, κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑ..
Heb. Jeremiah the prophet: (a ref. to).

[in LXX for קָשַׁב hi., שָׁמַר ni.,] 1. to turn to, bring to. 2. τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted: in sense of caring or providing for, π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself: id. before ἀπό, (without dative), before μή, with inf. (M, Pr., 193; Bl., § 69, 4). 3…
ἀπ-αίρω [in LXX chiefly for נָסַע;] to lift off, hence, to take away; pass..

to concede, confess, admit, give accolades, consent

[in LXX chiefly for ראה, also for פּנה,] 1. of bodily sight; (a) to see, have sight (opposite to τυφλὸς): (b) to perceive, look (at), see: absol., with accusative, ὅραμα, γυναῖκα, βιβλίον, τ. βλεπόμενα. 2. Metaphorical, of mental vision; (a) to see, perceive, discern: absol., δι ̓ ἐσόπτρου, with accusative, before ὅτι, (b) to consider…
adv., at once (Lat. simul): (one and all = יַחַד,), Phm 22; before σύν, as prep. with dative, together with: also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ, early in the morning.
τύ (πράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר;] 1. that which has been done, a deed, act. 2. That which is being done (like Lat. res), hence, a thing, matter, affair: in forensic sense, a law-suit.

(φυλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת and cogn. forms, also for כֶּלֶא;] (a) actively, a guarding, guard, watch: cogn. accusative, φυλάσσειν φυλακάς, to keep watch, (b) of those who keep watch (as also Lat. custodia), a guard; pl., sentinels, a guard: (with) of the place where persons are kept under guard…
negative particle, related to μήτε as οὐ to μή, and not, neither, nor: οὐδεὶς... οὔτε, οὐδὲ... οὔτε, οὔτε... καί, after a question with μή interrog., οὔτε... οὔτε, neither... nor, al
δια-βαίνω [in LXX chiefly for עבר;] 1. to make a stride. 2. to step across, cross over; (a) trans.: τ. θάλασσαι, (b) intrans.: before εἰς, πρός.

(πτώσσω, to crouch, cower), [in LXX for עָנִי, דַּל, רָשׁ,] of one who crouches and cowers, hence, 1. as subst., a beggar. 2. As adj., (a) prop., beggarly: metaphorically, στοιχεῖα, (b) in broader sense (opposite to πλούσιος), poor: π. τ. κόσμῳ, metaphorically, π. τ. πνεύματι. SYN.: πένης, q.v
(Rec. -άρεια), -ας, ἡ (Heb. שֹׁמְרוֹן; Aram. שָׁמְרַיִן), Samaria; (a) the city: (and perhaps also); (b) the region: (and perhaps also).

(ἔργον), [in LXX for עָבַד, פָּעַל, עָשָׂה,] 1. intrans., (a) to work, labour: b, τ. χερσίν, νυκτὸς κ. ἡαέρας, of working for pay, for reward, (b) to work at a trade or business, to trade: before Iv (Dem.). 2. Trans., (a) to work, work out, do, produce, perform: with accusative, before εἰς, III Jn 5; ἔργον, (LXX); id. before εἰς, ἐν…

ἐν-δύω (ἐνδύνω,), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ;] 1. with accusative of person(s), (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), ptcp., of armour (figuratively): metaphorically, δύναμιν, ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph, σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Ἰησ. Χριστόν, 2…

[in LXX for נַעַר, חָדָשׁ, compar. -ώτερος for קָטָן, צָעִיר,] 1. young, youthful. 2. new: οἶνος, φύραμα (figuratively), διαθήκη, metaphorically, ἄνθρωπος. 3. Compar., -ώτερος, -α, -ον, younger: pl., οἱ ν., (Rackham, in l), opposite to πρεσβύτεροι, αἱ ν.. 4. Νέα Πόλις, Neapolis: νεώτερος, see: νέος SYN.: καινός, which see

Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend; so mid., in NT (M, Pr., 158): before ὅτι, with accusative and inf., (MM, Exp.…

[in LXX chiefly for טָהֵר;] to cleanse, make clean. 1. In physical sense: with accusative of thing(s), figuratively, of disease (leprosy), with accusative of person(s), ἡ λέπρα ἐκαθερίσθη. 2. In ethical sense: τ. καρδίας, τ. χεῖρας, λαὸν ἑαυτῷ, τ. ἐκκλησίαν, with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), before ἀπό (131., § 36, 9; Deiss.…

(I), [in LXX chiefly for אסר;] to tie, bind, fasten; (1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, of an ass. (2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, δεδομένος τ. πόδας... κειρίαις, of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, captives, ἁλύσεσι. Metaphorical, ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ…

the more usual cl. form, darkness: Rec.

τό [in LXX chiefly for אוֹת;] a sign, mark, token; (a) of that which distinguishes a person or thing from others: before genitive epexeg., with genitive obj., with genitive subj., (b) a sign of warning or admonition: (with) a sign portending future events: (d) of miracles and wonders (MM, xxii)…

ἀφ-ίημι, [in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב,] 1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), of death, τ. πνεῦμα, (φωνήν, to utter a cry, of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, τ. ὀφειλήν, esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, " (LXX)…
[in LXX chiefly for חֲמוֹר, also for אָתוֹן,] an ass: " (LXX), " (LXX); ὁ, ἡ.

[in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, forty-six words in all;] to disturb, trouble, stir up: primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, [4]. Metaphorical, of the mind, to trouble, disquiet, perplex: ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l), of a crowd, to stir up, pass., " (LXX); τ. πνεύματι

(πλάνη), [in LXX chiefly for תָּעָה;] to cause to wander, lead astray. Pass., to go astray, wander. Metaphorical, to lead astray, deceive: with accusative of person(s), Jn Jn; pass., to be led astray, to err: τ. καρδίᾳ, ἀπὸ τ. ἀληθείας,μὴ πλανᾶσθε..

[in LXX chiefly for מַטֶּה (e.g., MT, מַטֶּה, bed), also for מַקֵּל, שֵׁבֶט,] a staff, rod: in particular, (a) a staff, such as is used on a journey: " (LXX); (b) a ruler's staff, a sceptre: (LXX); (with) a rod for chastisement: ἐν ῥ..

(προσεύχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּפִלָּה;] 1. prayer to God: (WH, R, txt., om.), pl., Phm 4 22, οἶκος προσευχῆς, " (LXX); π. καὶ δέησις, pl., ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, prayer to God (ef. Wis.16:28), πρὸς τ. θεόν, before ὑπέρ, pl., Hebraistically (B1., § 38, 3), προσευχῇ προσεύχεσθαι, (EV, prayed fervently). 2. a place of prayer: of a synagogue…

Metaphorical, without reference to numbers, by a reckoning of characteristics or reasons; (a) to reckon, take into account: with accusative of thing(s), id. before dative of person(s), (LXX)…

Metaphorical, to perceive, understand: (LXX), (WH, mg.), " (LXX), with accusative of thing(s), before ὅτι, before quæst. indir., ἐπὶ τ. ἄρτοις, as subst., συνίων (ὁ σ., WH, mg.), a man of understanding, i.e. in moral and religious sense, (LXX).
[in LXX chiefly for רָעָב;] hunger, famine: " (LXX), λ. καὶ δίψος, pl..

[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ,] to approach, draw near: absol., with infin., with dative loc., dative of person(s), and freq., ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., and freq., π. αὐτῷ, with indic., Metaphorical, (a) of approaching God: absol., τ. θεῷ, τ. θρόνῳ τ. χάριτος, πρὸς Χριστόν, (b) in sense not found elsewhere (Field, Notes, 211)…
τό (γίγνομαι), [in LXX for עַם, מִין, זֶרַע,] 1. family. 2. offspring. 3. race, nation. 4. kind, sort, class: Rec..
(ἀπόλλυμι), [in LXX (Cremer, 797) for אָבַד, אֵיד,] destruction, waste, loss, perishing: in special sense of the loss of eternal life, perdition, the antithesis of σωτηρία: (DB, iii, 744).

[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח, also for חָסָה, יָחַל pi., hi.,] to look for, expect, hope (for): with accusative of thing(s), with dative of thing(s) (τ. τύχῃ, Thuc., iii, 97, 2), before καθώς, with inf., II Jn 12, before ὅτι, with pres., with fut., Phm 22. As in LXX, with prep.; εἰς, before ὅτι, ἐπί, with dative, (LXX; ἐν, with accusative…
ἐπι-βλέπω [in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה,] to look upon. In NT, as in LXX, to look on with favour: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s).

(Att.. νεώς; ναίω, to inhabit), [in LXX chiefly for הֵיכָל;] 1. a temple. 2. The inmost part of a temple, the shrine; in NT, (a) generally: pl., of silver models of a heathen shrine, (b) of the temple building proper, or sanctuary, at Jerusalem, as distinct from τ. ἱερόν, the whole temple enclosure: (τοῦ) θεοῦ…

[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא;] 1. to fill, make full, fill to the full, with accusative; (a) of things: pass. (σαψήνη, φάραγξ), " (LXX); figuratively, but chiefly of immaterial things: πᾶσαν χρείαν, ἦχος ἐλήρωσε τ. οἶκον, with genitive of thing(s) (cl.), pass., before ἐκ, π. τ. καρδίαν, metaphorically…

ἀν-άγω [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi.;] to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν. Mid., in nautical sense, to put to sea.
[in LXX: (עָרִיץ) (עָלָה ni.), Da TH (רוּם), ib. LXX TH ff.*;] 1. to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place. 2. to extol (Da, ll. with).
(ἀδελφός), [in LXX for אָהוֹת;] a sister: metaphorically, of a member of the Christian community
(ψεύδομαι), [in LXX for שֶׁקֶר, שָׁוְא, כָּזָב;] lying, false, untrue (of persons and things): μάρτυρες, as subst., ὁ ψ., a liar.

[in LXX chiefly for רָדַף;] 1. to put to flight, drive away. 2. to pursue; (a) of persons; with accusative, without hostility, to follow after: with hostile purpose. Hence, to persecute: (b) metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), of seeking eagerly after: νόμον δικαιοσύνης, τ. φιλοξενίαν, εἰρήνην, τὰ τῆς εἰ., τ. ἀγάπην, τὸ ἀγαθόν…

ἐπ-έρχομαι, [in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר,] 1. to come to, arrive, come on: before ἀπό, with genitive loc., of time. 2. to come upon (as in Hom.): of calamities, of an enemy, of the Holy Spirit, [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί,].
ἄ-νομος, -ον (ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע,] 1. lawless, wicked: ὁ ἄ., (= ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας,). 2. without law (= οἱ μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον,). SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος

συλ-λαμβάνω [in LXX for תָּפַשׂ, הָרָה,] 1. with accusative, to bring together, collect. 2. to seize, take: with accusative of person(s), as a prisoner, pass., mid., in sense of act., σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων. 3. C. dative of person(s), to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense. 4. Of a woman, to conceive: absol., before ἐν γαστρί…

πίμπλημι [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, also for שָׂבַע;] trans. form in present and imperfect of πλήθω (intrans. in these tenses), which supplies the other tense forms; to fill: with accusative, with accusative and genitive, pass., of that which fills or takes possession of the mind: pass., with genitive…
adv. (for καθ᾽ ἅ), [in LXX: (אֲשֶׁר, כְּ), Wis.3:10,] just as, according as: (LXX), D.
Dep. to propitiate, (Oracle quoted in Herdotus Historicus)
[in LXX chiefly for פָּדָה, גָּאַל;] to release on receipt of ransom; mid., to release by paying ransom, to redeem: in spiritual sense, pass, in general sense, to deliver.

[in LXX for בָּטַח and its derivatives, תִּקְוָה (frequently in Jb),] expectation (in cl., rarely of evil, mostly of good, and so always in NT), hope; 1. of hope in general: with genitive obj., art. inf., παρ᾽ ἐλπίδα, ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι. 2. Of religious hope: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, τῇ ἐ. ἐσώθημεν, κατ᾽ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου, of the Messianic hope of Israel…

adv. (ἐξ), [in LXX for חוּץ;] 1. outside, without; (a) adverbially: with art., ὁ ἔ., he who is without; metaphorically, in pl., οἱ ἔ., of those outside the Church, (Lft., in l), ὁ ἔ. ἄνθρωπος, αἱ ἔ. πόλεις, (b) as prep. with genitive: 2. After verbs of motion; (a) adverbially, forth, out: (b) as prep. with genitive, out of: al

adv., [in LXX for עֵבֶר and cognate forms;] on the other side, across (usually with the idea of water lying between); (a) as in the older poets, as prep. with genitive: τ. θαλάσσης, τ. Ἰορδάνου, (LXX), τ. χειμάρρου τ. Κέδρων, (b) τὸ π., the region beyond, the other side: τ. θαλάσσης, τ. λίμνης.
neg. adv. of time, [in LXX chiefly for עוֹד with neg., לֹא,] no longer, no more: with neg. (to strengthen the negation), al

[in LXX chiefly for למד pl., also for ידע hi., ירה hi.,] to teach (i.e. instruct) a person, teach a thing; 1. trans.: with accusative of person(s), before ὅτι, περί, with inf., with accusative of thing(s), with cogn. accusative, (LXX); with dupl. accusative, pass., with dative of person(s). 2. Absol., to teach…

(= μή ποτε, and so written in WH, exc.), negative particle, related to οὔποτε as μή to οὐ. 1. As neg. particle, never. 2. As conjc., lest ever, lest haply (the idea of chance rather than of time seems to prevail in NT): (LXX) " (LXX), " (LXX), after verbs of fearing or taking heed, with ellipse of the verb or ptcp., in later writers…

[in LXX chiefly for פָּלַל hith.;] to pray (always of prayer to God, or in cl., to gods): absol., (WH, E, txt., om.) (WH, E, mg., om.), before λέγων, with dative instr., μακρά, (WH, R, txt., om.), ἐν πνεύματι (ἁγίῳ), Ju 20; προσευχῇ π., with accusative of thing(s), before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), with dative of person(s)…
κατ-ισχύω [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק;] to overpower, prevail against, prevail: absol., with inf., with genitive.
(κοῖλος, hollow), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּטֶן, מֵעֶה, קֶרֶב, also for רֶחֶם;] 1. the belly (stomach or intestines or both). 2. (As often in LXX) the womb: ἐκ κ. μητρός. 3. Metaphorical, of the heart.

ἀνα-στρέφω [in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב;] 1. to overturn. 2. to turn back, return. 3. to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: Rec.; metaphorically, to conduct oneself, behave, live. SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω

(ἰσχύς), [in LXX for חָזַק, גִּבּוֹר, עָצַם,] 1. to be strong in body. 2. to be powerful, have power, prevail: before κατά, with genitive of person(s), with inf., to be able (MM, Exp., xv): (inf. understood), with accusative, of things, to avail, be serviceable (MM, Exp., l.with).
τό (ὕπνος), [in LXX chiefly for חֲלוֹם;] a dream: pl..

[in LXX chiefly for קָנָה;] in pres., impf., fut. and aor., to procure for oneself, get, gain, acquire (the pf. and plpf., to have acquired, hence to possess, do not occur in NT): with accusative of thing(s), with genitive pret., ἐκ with genitive pret., τ,ψυχὰς ὑμῶν (MM, xvi), τ. ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι.

[in LXX for אַחֵר,אֶחָד,] other, another: absol., ἄ. δέ, pl., attached to a noun, with art., ὁ ἄ., the other, οἱ ἄ., the others, the rest, ἄ. πρὸς ἄλλον = πρὸς ἀλλήλους, ἄλλ᾽ (i.e. ἄλλο) ἤ, before πλήν, εἰ μή, παρά with accusative. SYN.: ἕτερος, which see ἄ. denotes numerical, ἕ. qualitative difference (Cremer, 89). ἄ…
[in LXX chiefly for כֶּבֶשׂ;] a lamb: figuratively, of Christ (DCG, ii, 620b), " (LXX).
(βοή + θέω, to run), [in LXX chiefly for עזר;] to come to aid, to help, succour: absol., with dative, " (LXX).

[in LXX chiefly for מָעַט;] of number, quantity, size, few, little, small, slight: (sc. πληγάς, opposite to πολλάς), οὐκ ὀ., (with genitive part.); pl., absol., (WH, txt., RV, om.). Neut. sing (τὸ) ὀ.: πρὸς ὀλίγον, ἐν ὀ., id., in brief, adverbially, ὀλίγον, of time, of space, pl., ὀλίγα, ἐπ᾽ ὀλίγα, δι᾽ ὀλίγων, in few words, briefly…
(-ία, Τ), -ας, ἡ (παιδεύω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּסָר;] 1. the rearing of a child (Æsch.). 2. training, learning, instruction. 3. As in LXX, chasten­ing, discipline: (LXX).
rel. adv. of time, at which time, when; before αν, with subjc., whensoever.

ἐκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν (ἐκλέγω), [in LXX for בָּחַר (so prob. in, for MT בָּחַן), בָּרִיא,] 1. choice, select, hence, eminent. 2. As in Inscr. (MM, Exp., xii), chosen; esp. as in LXX, of Israel, elect, chosen of God; so in NT; (a) of Christ: figuratively, λίθος, (LXX); (b) of holy angels: (with) of Christians: τ. θεοῦ, τ. Χριστοῦ, ἐ. κυρία…
and τό, [in LXX chiefly for עֹשֶׁר;] riches, wealth: of external possessions, of moral and spiritual conceptions.
[in LXX for עָמָל,] 1. labour, toil: 2. The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain. SYN.: see: κόπος

(λάτρις, a hired servant), [in LXX (always, as λατρεία, of the service of God or of heathen divinities) chiefly for עָבַד, in Dan LXX TH for פְּלַח;] 1. to work for hire. 2. to serve; in cl., also of divine service, to serve, worship, and so always in NT: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, " (LXX), of idol worship, τ. θεῷ. ἐν τ…
(Rec. σκύλον), -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלָל;] mostly in pl., σκίλα, arms stripped from a foe, spoils.

(λειτουργός), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת pi., also for עָבַד, צָבָא,] 1. in cl., at Athens, to supply public offices at one's own cost, render public service to the State, hence, generally, 2. to serve the State, do a service, serve (of service to the Gods, Diod., i, 21): of the official service of priests and Levites…
(dimin. of νεανίας) [in LXX chiefly for נַעַר, also for בָּחוּר,] a young man, youth: " (LXX); of an attendant.

(Bl., -ῄ-, § 3, 3), [in LXX chiefly for זָכַר;] to remind: mid, and pass.; (a) reflexive, to remind oneself of, hence, to remember: with genitive of thing(s), Ju 17; with neg., of sins, = to forgive, " (LXX); with genitive of person(s), before ὅτι, ὡς, pf., μέμνημι, in Pres. sense (cl.), with genitive of person(s) (of thing(s)), pres.…
(ἄμπελος), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם;] a vineyard: ff. ff, ff.. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., see MM, VGT, see word; LS, see word ἀμπελουργεῖον.)
stiff fat, tallow, suet, Lat. sebum, opp. toπιμελή (Lat. adeps, soft fat), (Odyssey by Homer)
ἐπ-ακούω [in LXX for שָׁמַע, עָנָה,] 1. to listen to. 2. to hearken to, hear with favour (one's prayer): with genitive of person(s), (LXX).
ῆς, ἡ (πλήσσω), [in LXX chiefly for מַכָּה, also for מַגֵּפָה;] 1. a blow, stripe, wound: pl., ἡ π. τ. θανάτου (RV, death-stroke), τ. μαχαίρας. 2. Metaphorical, a calamity, plague.
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹפָר, חֲצֹצְרָה;] a trumpet, used in war and in religious ceremonies: By meton., a trumpet blast: μετὰ σ. μεγάλης, ἐν σ. θεοῦ, ἐν τ. ἐσχάτῃ σ..

(ἐκ-καλέω), [in LXX chiefly for קָהָל, otherwise for one of its cogn. forms;] 1. prop., an assembly of citizens regularly convened (in Thuc., ii, 22, opposite to σύλλογος, a concourse): 41. 2. In LXX of the assembly, congregation, community of Israel: " (LXX). 3. NT, esp. of an assembly or company of Christians, a (the) church…
[in LXX chiefly for עַיִן, also for מָקוֹר,] a spring, fountain: τ. δάτων, of a well fed by a spring, π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, metaphorically.

[in LXX for זָעַק, צָעַק, קָרָא,] in cl. chiefly poët., 1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out: (Rec., R, mg.), of crying for vengeance. 2. to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), before orat. dir., (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, λέγων, of public teaching…

[in LXX chiefly (ὁ θλίβων,) for צוּר;] to press: with accusative of person(s), ὁδὸς τεθλιμμένη, a narrow (compressed) way. Metaphorical (as frequently in LXX), to oppress, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), pass. (Vg., tribulor, tribulation em patior).
[in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר,] left remaining: ἱο κ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, (LXX).
τά indecl. numeral, twelve: οἱ δ., the apostles, in, for Rec. δεκαδύο.

ἀπο-καλύπτω [in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה] 1. in general sense (cl.), to reveal, uncover, disclose, (a) of things: (b) of persons: pass., Christ, Antichrist, 2. In LXX and NT, in special sense of divine revelation: ib., (Westc., Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 149 f.). SYN.: φανερόω.
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף;] of silver: (WH, br.).
ἀπ-έναντι adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX); 1. over against: WH, mg. 2. before, in the presence of: (WH, mg.). 3. against.

and ῥιπτέω, [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi.;] 1. to throw, cast, hurl: with accusative of thing(s), with accusative of person(s), pass., ptcp., ἐριμμένοι, cast down, prostrate: of garments, to throw off. 2. = ῥιπτάζω, to shake, toss, throw about: τ. ἱμάτια.
ἀνα-λαμβάνω [in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא, also for לָקַח,] 1. to take up, raise. 2. to take up, take to oneself.
(στέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּגֶד, also for לְבוּשׁ,] 1 1, an equipment, an armament (Æsch.). 2. Equipment in clothes, apparel, esp. flowing raiment, a festal robe.
(a Cyrenaїc word, Hdt., iv, 199), [in LXX chiefly for גִּבְעָה;] a hill: (LXX).
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף; in (אָכַל pu.), distinguished from καίω;] to burn up, burn completely: with accusative of thing(s), pass., before πυρί, ἐν πυρί.

(τίθημι), [in LXX chiefly for אוֹצָר;] 1. a place of safe keeping; (a) a casket: (b) a treasury (1Ma.3:29 and frequently in cl.); (with) a storehouse: metaphorically, of the soul, τ. καρδίας, 2. a treasure: θ. ἐν οὐρανῷ, of the knowledge of God through Christ, τ. σοφίας κ. γνώσεως.

(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר,] the remaining, the rest, 1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., absol., οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, τὰ λ., 2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.; (a) for the future, henceforth: (Lft., Notes, 232 f.), anarth. (Deiss., LAE, 17616, 1885, 20), τοῦ λ., (b) besides…
εἰσ-φέρω [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא hi.;] to bring in, into: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς, pass..

[in LXX chiefly for בְּרָכָה;] 1. fair speaking, flattering speech: χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐ.. 2. praise: of God and Christ, 3. In LXX and NT: blessing, benediction; (a) the act of blessing: (b) concrete, a blessing.
ύπο-κάτω comp. adv., [in LXX chiefly for תַּחַת;] below, under: as prep. with genitive, (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), " (LXX).

(τελευτή), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת;] 1. trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die. 2. Intrans., to come to an end, hence, to die: Hebraistically, θανάτῳ τελευτάτω (מוּת,), " (LXX).

ἐκ-βάλλω [in LXX chiefly for גָּרַשׁ pi., also for שָׁלַךְ hi., יָצָא hi., יָרַשׁ hi.,] 1. to drive, cast or send out, to expel: with accusative of thing(s), mid. (σῖτον), before εἰς, pass., with accusative of person(s), δαιμόνια, id. before ἐκ, παρά, ἐν, (ἐν) τ. ὀνόματι, λόγῳ, before ἔξω, id. with genitive, of expulsion from home…

[in LXX for הָיָה, יֵשׁ, לוּן, τ. ὑπάρχοντα for מִקְנֶה, רְכוּשׁ,] 1. to begin, make a beginning. 2. to be in existence, be ready, be at hand: before ἐν. 3. to be, prop, expressing continuance of an antecedent state or condition: with, nom, pred., ptcp. with pred., pl., before ἐν, with dative of thing(s), ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων (R, mg.…
adv., (κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב;] from all sides, round about
(κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבַב;] 1. to move in a circle, revolve. 2. to surround, encircle: with accusative of person(s), pass..
dimin, of παῖς, [in LXX for שִׁפְחָה, אָמָה,] 1. a young girl, a maiden (נַעֲרָה,). 2. Colloq., a young female slave, a maid-servant: of Hagar, " (LXX); id., metaphorically. SYN.: see: παῖς

παρ-ίστημι [in LXX for עָמַד,] I. Transitive verb. in present tense., imperfect., future tense., 1 aorist.; 1. to place beside, present, provide: with accusative, with accusative and dative, before accusative pred., (late pres., παριστάνετε). 2. to present to the mind (cl.): by argument, to prove, with accusative. II. Intransitive…
[in LXX for חָמַל, חוּס, חָשַׂךְ,] to spare: with genitive of person(s), with inf., to forbear.

see: ἐγώ. ἐγώ, genitive, ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I. (a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in, But often there is no apparent emphasis, as, ἰδοὺ ἐ., ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, (LXX), (LXX). (b) The enclitic forms are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs…

καθ-αιρέω, -ῶ [in LXX for נָתַץ, פָּרַץ, יָרַד,] 1. to take down: with accusative of person(s) (the technical term for removal after crucifixion, Field, Notes, 44). 2. to put down by force, pull down, destroy: ἀποθήκας, (opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν); δυνάστας, ἔθνη, pass., (diminished, Field, Notes, 129 f.); figuratively, to refute: λογισμούς.

τό (εἶδος), [in LXX for אֱלוֹהָּ, גְּלוּלִים,] 1. in cl. (a) a phantom, image, likeness; (b) an image in the mind, an idea, fancy. 2. In LXX and NT, (a) an image of a god, an idol: (b) the false god or idol worshipped in an image (ICC, on I Th, l.with).
[in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶב, also for דָּרוֹם, תֵּימָן and קָדִים;] 1. prop., the south wind: 2. South: 3. the South, as a region.
[in LXX chiefly for סֶלַע, צוּר;] a rock, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, a detached stone or boulder: of a hollow rock, a cave. Metaphorical, = πέτρος, " (LXX).
(οἶκος), [in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁב;] (a) trans., to inhabit: with accusative, (b) intrans., to dwell: before μετά (of married life), metaphorically, before ἐν: ἀγαθόν, ἁμαρτία, πνεῦμα θεοῦ.
(εὔχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for נָדַר;] 1. a prayer. 2. a vow. SYN.: see: δέησις
[in LXX for קֶצַח, בֹּהֶן,] highest, extreme; as subst., τὸ ἄ., the top, extremity: pl..
[in LXX for בָּעַר, יָקַד, שָׂרַף,] 1. to kindle, light: with accusative, λύχνον, pass., to be lighted, to burn: ptcp., πυρί, metaphorically. 2. to burn, destroy by fire: pass..

(συντελέω), [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה and (in Da) for קוּם;] 1. in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.). 2. In late writers, consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων.

(αἶσχος, shame), [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ;] 1. to disfigure (Hom.). 2. to dishonour. 3. to make ashamed (Sir.13:7). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: with inf. (M, Pr., 205), (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω).
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גָּדַל pi., hi.;] 1. to make great. 2. to declare great, extol, magnify: pass., before ἐν.
1. a pond for water-fowl, Lat. vivarium, (Herdotus Historicus) 2. a pit, reservoir, (Herdotus Historicus)
(ἀφανής), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם ni., שָׁמַד hi.,] 1. to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., a1.). 2. Later (a) to destroy: (b) to disfigure. Pass., to vanish: to perish: (LXX).

ἀφ-ορίζω [in LXX (Cremer, 805 f.) for בָּדַל hi., סָגַר hi., נוּף hi., רוּם hi;] (a) to mark off by boundaries from, separate from: with accusative, id. before ἐκ (ἀπό), of excom­munication. Pass., absol., (b) to set apart, devote to a special purpose (before εἰς): with accusative. Mid., (DB, iii 588).
(-ους), τό [in LXX chiefly for אֹרֶךְ;] length.
pl., κρέα [in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.);] flesh, meat.
[in LXX chiefly for נַחַל, also for גַּיְא,] a chasm, ravine: (LXX).
(ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for אַלּוּף, שַׂר,] 1. a leader, guide. 2. a commander. 3. a governor of a province: of the Procurator of Judæa. 4. For Heb. אַלְפֵי (LXX, χίλιαι) misread אַלֻּפֵי, leaders: (OT).

(βουλή), [in LXX chiefly for יעץ;] to take counsel, deliberate, resolve. In mid., 1. to take counsel with oneself, consider: before εἰ. 2. to determine with oneself, resolve: with inf., with accusative, before ἵνα.
(βέβηλος), [in LXX chiefly for חלל;] to profane: τ. σάββατον, τ. ἱερόν, (Cremer, 141). SYN.: κοινόω, which see

[in LXX for כְּמוֹ,] like, resembling, such as, the same as: with dative, of form or appearance, (B1., § 37, 62) Rev_9:19; Rev_11:1; Rev_13:2; Rev_13:11; ὁράσει, Rev_4:3; of nature, condition, ability, Mat_22:39, Act_17:29, Gal_5:21, 1Jn_3:2, Rev_13:4; Rev_18:18; Rev_21:11; Rev_21:18; of comparison in parables, Mat_13:31 ff. Mat_20:1…
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת;] to die; pf. (M, Pr., 114), to be dead: metaphorically, of spiritual death.

(γράμμα), [in LXX always for שׁטר in Hex., elsewhere chiefly for ספר;] 1. a secretary; γ. τ. πόλεως, a state-clerk. 2. In π., of a military officer (Deiss., BS, 110f.). So (ספר), 3. a scribe, a biblical scholar, teacher of the law (so first in I, II; in, νομοδιδάσκαλος; in, νομικός): and frequently in Gosp. γ. καὶ ἀρχιερεῖς, and; γ. κ…
(προοελαύνω), [in LXX for גֵּר;] 1. one who has arrived, a stranger. 2. Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte.
ἄ-μωμος, -ον, [in LXX chiefly for תָּמִים]; of sacrificial victims, without blemish: of Christ, etbically, unblemished, faultless: Ju 24. SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄσπιλος

(εὐλογέω), [in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ;] blessed; (a) of men ( A, B,); (b) of God (Lft., Notes, 310 f.), as chiefly in LXX: (ICC, in l), absol., ὁ εὐλογητός (Dalman, Words, 200; JThS, v, 453), (Cremer, 769).
[in LXX chiefly for רָדַף;] "perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116), to pursue closely, follow up (a) with hostile intent; (b) with kindly intention.

adv., [in LXX for חֲלֹם,פֹּה,הִנֶּה,] 1. prop., of manner, so. 2. In poets (rarely) and late writers, of place, (a) hither: ἕως ὧδε, (b) here: τὰ ὧδε, opposite to ἐκεῖ, ὧδε... ἢ ὧδε (ἐκεῖ), metaphorically, here (i.e. in this circumstance or connection).

[in LXX almost always for כָּסָה pi.;] in cl., rare in prose, to cover: with accusative of person(s), with accusative of thing(s) and dative, pass., metaphorically, to veil, conceal: pf. ptcp. pass., of the forgiveness of sins: (seel. for καιομένη, WH, mg.,).

(ψάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְמוֹר;] 1. a striking, twitching with the fingers, hence, a striking of musical strings (Æsch., a1.), and hence in later writers, 2. a sacred song sung to musical accompaniment, a psalm (LXX): of OT psalms, βίβλος ψαλμῶν. SYN.: see: ὕμνος
adv., [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶד, פָּנִים,] over against, opposite, before: ἡ, κ. κώμη, as prep., with genitive, (ἀπ-, WH, mg.), (ἀπ-, WH, mg.); metaphorically, before, before θεοῦ.
(ἔκδικος), [in LXX for פָּקַד, נָקַם, שָׁפַט,] 1. to vindicate: with accusative of person(s). 2. to avenge: with accusative of person(s), ἑαυτούς, with accusative of thing(s), παρακοήν, αἷμα.
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַט;] to slay, slaughter: ἀρνίον, of persons, ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death).

[in LXX chiefly for מֵת;] dead, I. as adj., 1. prop.: ὡσεὶ ν., of that which is subject to death. 2. Metaphorical, (a) of persons: of those immersed in worldly cares, of spiritual death, τ. παραπτώμασιν, of the opposite condition, ν. τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, (b) of things regarded as inoperative, devoid of power: ἁμαρτία, πίστις, ἔργα. II. As subst.…

[in LXX for קוּם,עמד,] to stay, abide, remain. 1. Intrans.; (i) of place: before ἐν, παρά, with dative of person(s), al; σύν, καθ᾽ ἑαυτόν, with adv., ἐκεῖ, ὧδε, metaphorically, of the Holy Spirit, of Christ, ὁ θεός, conversely, of Christians, ὁ λόγος τ. θεοῦ, ἡ ἀλήθεια, II Jo 2, (ii) Of time; (a) of persons: before εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, ὀλίγον…
ή [in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר;] a song, ode, whether sad or joyful; in LXX and NT always in praise of God or Christ: ᾠ πνευματικαί.

(δέομαι), [in LXX for תְּחִנָּה, רִנָּה, תְּפִלָּה,] 1. a wanting, need (so Ps 21(22):25). 2. an asking, entreaty, supplica­tion; in NT always addressed to God: " (LXX); with νηστεῖαι, προσυνχή, -αί, ἱκετηρίαι, προσκαρτέρησις, ἐντεύξεις, δ. ποιεῖσθαι (Deiss., BS, 250), (pl.), before ὑπέρ, περί, πρός. SYN.: προσευχή…
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX chiefly for בּשֶׁת;] shame: subjectively, objectively, as something to be ashamed of, pl., shameful deeds, Ju 13. SYN.: αἰδώς, which see
ἀν-αιρέω, -ῶ [in LXX for הָרַג hi., מוּת hi., נָכָה hi.,] 1. to take up: mid.. 2. to take away, make an end of, destroy; (a) of things: (b) of persons, to kill: WH, txt., R, txt.

adv., [in LXX for שׁוּב,] 1. of place, back, backwards. 2. Of time, again, once more: (and freq.), al; pleonastically, π. ἀνακάμπτειν, ὑποστρέφειν, εἰς τὸ π., π. ἐκ τρίτου, ἐκ δευτέρου, π. δεῦτερον, π. ἄνωθεν ( Wis.19:6). 3. Rhetorically, again; (a) further, moreover: (b) in turn, on the other hand.

[in LXX chiefly for אמן hi.;] 1. intrans., to have faith (in), to believe; in cl., with accusative, dative, in NT also with prep, absol., with accusative of thing(s), with dative of person(s) (to believe what one says),[13, 14], τ. ψεύδει, περί... ὅτι, esp. and most frequently with reference to religious belief: absol., before ὅτι…
ὑπο-λείπω [in LXX chiefly (pass.) for יָתַר ni., שָׁאַר ni.;] to leave remaining: pass., of survivors.

πλέον, see: πολύς. πολύς, πολλή, πολύ, [in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms;] 1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, ἀριθμός, ὄχλος, θερισμός, χόρτος, χρόνος, γογγυσμός, πόνος, δόξα, σιγή, pl., προφῆται, ὄχλοι, δαιμόνια, δυνάμεις, 2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): with genitive partit.…

[in LXX chiefly for שׁאל;] to ask, request: absol., with accusative of person(s), with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, id. before παρά, with dupl. accusative. Mid.: absol., with accusative of thing(s), with accusative of person(s), with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, with accusative and inf.. with inf.. SYN.: ἐρωτάω, which see…

[in LXX chiefly for שֻׁלְחָן, also for לֶחֶם,] 1. a table, dining-table: of the table of shewbread. By meton., of food provided: " (LXX); διακονεῖν ταῖς τ.. 2. A money-changer's table, a bank: so also accusative to Dr. Field (Notes, 113).

ὑπο-μένω [in LXX chiefly for קָוָה, also for יָחַל hi.,] 1. in-trans., to stay behind: before ἐν, ἐκεῖ. 2. Trans., (a) with accusative, to await, wait for: (b) of things, to bear patiently, endure: absol., τ. θλίψει (dative of circumstance), before εἰς, with accusative of thing(s). SYN.: μακροθυμέω
[in LXX for רָעָה;] a shepherd: " (LXX), Metaphorical, of Christ; of Christian pastors.
(for καθ᾽ ἅπερ = καθά) adv., [in LXX for אֲשֶׁר,] just as, even as.

[in LXX for כָּרַת, סָפַד, נָכָה hi.,] 1. to strike, smite. 2. to cut off: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, ἐκ. Mid., to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail: with accusative of person(s), before ἐπί, with accusative. SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v
ἐμ-βάλλω [in LXX for שׂוּם,] to cast into: before εἰς.
ἀντ-απο-δίδωμι (ἀντί ἀποδίδωμι), [in LXX for שָׁלַם pi., גָּמַל, שׁוּב hi.,] to give back as an equivalent, recompense, requital; (a) in favourable sense: (b) in unfavourable sense.
ἐκ-δίκησις, -εως, ἡ (ἐκδικέω), [in LXX chiefly for נָקָם;] vengeance, vindication: (LXX), of the injured person, with genitive, with dative, of the offender, with genitive obj., with dative.
(ὕω, to rain), [in LXX chiefly for;] rain: ὄψιμος, sc. ὑ..

(in Attic usually -ος, -ον), [in LXX chiefly for of person(s) suff., also for לָהֶם, (τὰ ἴ.) בֵּיתוֹ;] 1. one's own; (a) of that which is private and personal; (b) of property, friends, home, country, Ju 6, πράσσειν τὰ ἴ., κατὰ τὰς ἰ. ἐπιθυμίας, οἱ ἴδιοι, (M, Pr., 90f.; Field, Notes, 84), τὰ ἴδια, one's home (Field, Notes, l.with). 2…
τό (δέρω), [in LXX for עוֹר;] the skin, hide of beasts: ἐν αἰγίοις δ..
[in LXX chiefly for דָּגָן;] wheat, corn. σιτίοι, -ου, τό (dimin. of σῖτος), [in LXX: (לֶחֶם)*;] 1. corn, grain. 2. Mostly in pl., σιτία, bread, food, provisions.
Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878) Levi; 1. the son of Jacob. 2. Son of Melchi. 3. Son of Simeon. 4. Son of Alphæus: (WH, mg., Ἰάκωβον).
τό (θυμιάω), [in LXX chiefly for קְטֹרֶת;] fragrant stuff for burning, incense: ἡ ὥρα τοῦ θ., θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θ., pl..

correlat. of οἷος, ὁποῖος, ὥς, such as this, of such a kind, such: (T, τούτων), οἷος... τ., id. pleonast., before ὁποῖος, ὥς, Phm 9. As subst., anarth: pl., with art., ὁ τ., such a one: pl., neut. pl., al

a Greek name (transliterated סִימוֺן in Heb.) used as a substitute for Συμεών, Simon 1. Simon Peter: 2. Simon the Zealot. 3. One of the Brethren of our Lord. 4. The father of Judas Iscariot, himself surnamed Ἰσκαριώτης: (Rec.) 5. Simon the Cyrenian. 6. Simon the Pharisee. 7. Simon of Bethany, surnamed ὁ λεπρός. 8. Simon Magus…
(δέκα), [in LXX for מַעֲשֵׂר and cognate forms;] tenth: (WH, txt., RV omit).
(ὄζω), [in LXX chiefly for רֵיחַ;] a smell, odour: metaphorically (EV, savour), of the effect of sacrifice, ὀ. εὐωδίας.
1. a goat, Lat. caper, capra, (Homer) 2. αἲξ ἄγριος the wild goat, the ibex, (Homer) 3. αἶγες, old name for waves. Prob. not from ἀί̈σσω, of which the root is αικ.

[in LXX chiefly for נָדַד, also for עָתַר hi.,] to pray: with accusative of thing(s), with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, before πρὸς τ. θεόν, with accusative and inf., before ὑπέρ, ηὐχόμην εἶναι, (Cremer, 718).

δια-ρήσσω (so WH, exc. Ac, l.with), δια-ρρήσσω (poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא;] to break asunder, burst, rend: δεσμά, pass., δίκτυα, ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger.
τό (γεννάω), [in LXX chiefly for תְּבוּאָה;] offspring of men or animals: ἐχιδνῶν.
(πένομαι, to work for one's daily bread), [in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, עָנִי, דַּל,] one who works for his living, a labourer, a poor man. SYN.: πτωχός, properly a beggar and implying deeper poverty than π.
δια-φθείρω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi.;] 1. to destroy utterly: pass., to be destroyed, disabled. 2. In moral sense, to corrupt, deprave: τ. γῆν, pass., διεφθαρμένοι τ. νοῦν.
(in Hom., κοῖτος) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁכָּב, also for שְׁכָבָה,] a bed: esp. the marriage-bed: κ. ἀμίαντος, κ. ἔχειν, of a woman conceiving, of illicit intercourse, pl..
(παίς), [in LXX chiefly for יָסַר;] 1. as in cl., to train children, hence, generally, to teach, instruct. 2. As in LXX, to chasten, correct, chastise: of divine chastening. SYN.: διδάσκω, q.v
τό (σκηνόω), [in LXX chiefly for אֹהֶל;] a tent, tabernacle: of the temple as God's dwelling. Metaphorical, of the body.

(ἔξεστι), [in LXX: 4, (114):2 135 (136)8, 9, (51):28 (מֶמְשָׁלָה), frequently in Da for Aram. שָׁלְטָן, Wis.10:14, Sir.9:13,] 1. prop., liberty or power to act, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις: ἐ. ἔχειν, id. before inf., with genitive obj., before ἐπί, with accusative, περί. 2. Later…

οἶδα, [in LXX chiefly for ידע;] pf. with present meaning, to have seen or perceived, hence, to know, have knowledge of: with accusative of thing(s), with accusative of person(s), τ. θεόν, with accusative and inf., before ὅτι, before quaest. indir., with inf., to know how (cl.), in unique sense of respect, appreciate. SYN.: see: γινώσκω.
τό [in LXX chiefly for קֶשֶׁת;] a bow.

[in LXX for עֵרֶךְ, יְקָר,] a valuing, hence, objectively; 1. a price paid or received: with genitive of person(s), with genitive of thing(s), pl., τ. αἵματος, ἠγοράσθητε τιμῆς, ὠνεῖσθαι τιμῆς ἀργυρίου. 2. esteem, honour: τ. διδόναι, ἔχειν, τ. καὶ δόξα (δ. κ. τ.), " (LXX), τ. καὶ κράτος, εἰς τ., ἐν τ., by meton., of marks of honour.
[in LXX chiefly for צַוַּאר, also forעֹרֶף,] the neck: ἐπιπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τὸν τ., to embrace. Metaphorical, ὑποθεῖναι τὸν ἑαυτοῦ τ., ἐπιθεῖναι ζυγὸν ἐπὶ τὸν τ..
interj., with vocat., O; (a) in simple address (less frequently than in cl.; M, Pr., 71); expressing reproof, (b) in exclamations of surprise, with nom..
[in LXX chiefly for מִגְדָּל;] a tower: of a watch-tower in a vineyard: and prob..
all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as; or after, as]; absol., in masc., as; in neut., as; ἅ. οὗτοι, (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac

(as in Att.., but -αία, -αιον, μάτην), [in LXX for שָׁוְא, הֶבֶל, כָּזָב,] vain, useless: ἀνωφελὴς κ. μ., πίστις, θρησκεία, διαλογισμοί, (LXX); ἀναστροφή, of idols and heathen gods, τὰ μ.: SYN.: κενός, q.v
[in LXX chiefly for קִיר;] a wall, esp. of a house: figuratively.
(ὀνειδίζω) [in LXX chiefly for חֶרְפָּה;] a reproach: εἰς ὀ. ἐμπεαεῖν, ὁ ὀ. τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

ἐκ-φέρω [in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi.;] 1. to carry out, bring out: with accusative of thing(s), with accusative of person(s), of the dead for burial. 2. to bring forth; (a) of women; (b) of the ground (Hdt.).

[in LXX for כָּלָה pi.,] to make to cease, restrain, hinder: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό (LXX). Mid., to cease, leave off: with ptcp., with genitive, ἀμαρτίας, (WH, mg., R, txt.); with dative, ib. (WH, txt., R, mg.).

1. conformable to custom, usage, or law, customary, prescriptive, established, lawful, rightful, (Euripides):—; νόμιμόν [ ἐστί] τινι ποιεῖν τι (Xenophon Historicus) 2. νόμιμα, ων, τά, usages, customs, (Herdotus Historicus), attic 3. funeral rites, Lat. justa, (Thucydides) 4. adverb -μως…
ἐξ-εγείρω [in LXX for עוּר ni., hi.,] to raise up: from the dead.

(έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חֶמֶד,] desire, longing: p1., esp. with ref. to forbidden things, desire, lust (Vg., concupiscentia): pl., πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, ἐ. κακή, with genitive, μιασμοῦ, τ. καρδιῶν, τ. κόσμου (aroused by the world), τ. σώματος, τ. ἀπάτης, τ. σαρκός, (without art.), τ. ὀφθαλμῶν, σαρκικαὶ ἐ.…

[in LXX chiefly for רִיק and cognate forms;] empty. Metaphorical, (a) empty, vain: λόγοι, ἀπάτη, κήρυγμα, πίστις, (b) vain, fruitless: ἡ χάρις, κόπος, ἡ εἴσοδος, κενά, (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), (with) of persons, empty-handed: vain. SYN.: μάταιος, of the aim or effect of an action, κ…
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף;] a wing: of birds, of creatures seen in a vision.

(σάλος), [in LXX for מוֹט, זוּעַ,] prop., of the action of wind, storm, to agitate, shake: of a reed, a house, the earth, the heavenly bodies, of a vessel shaken in filling. Metaphorical, (a) to shake, i.e. to render insecure: τὰ σαλευόμενα, τὰ μὴ., (b) with accusative of person(s)…

[in LXX for שָׂמַח, גִּיל, inf., as greeting, שָׁלוֹם), 1Ma.10:18, 2Ma.1:1 and frequently in these books;] 1. to rejoice, be glad: χ. καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθαι, κ. σκιρτᾶν, opposite to κλαίειν, to κλαίειν κ. θρηνεῖν; to λύπην ἔχειν, with cogn. accusative, χ. χαρὰν μεγάλην, χαρᾷ χ. (B1., § 38, 3; Dalman, Words, 34 f.), ἡ χαρὰ ᾗ χαίρομεν, with prep…
τό (μνήμων, mindful), [in LXX frequently for זֵכֶר, זִכְרוֹן and cogn. forms;] a memorial.

ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית;] 1. the beginning of a sacrifice. 2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: of Christians: of Christ.

κατ-αισχύνω [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ;] to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame: with accusative of thing(s), with accusative of person(s), pass., to be ashamed: as in LXX, of unfulfilled hopes: pass., " (LXX).

[in LXX: (צבא), (עֲדִי), (כְּלִי), Wis.2:24 and freq., Sir.6:30, al;] 1. order. 2. ornament, adornment, esp. of women. 3. Later, the world or universe, as an ordered system: 4. In late writers only, the world, i.e. the earth:[15], hence by meton.…
τό, [in LXX chiefly for אֹכֶל;] food: pl., trop., of spiritual food.
ἐπ-αίρω [in LXX for נָשָׂא, רוּם,] to lift up, raise: τ. ἀρτέμονα, χεῖρας, κεφαλάς, ὀφθαλμούς, φωνήν, τ. πτέρναν (figuratively). Pass., metaphorically, to be lifted up with pride.
[in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב;] the understanding, mind: pl., in quotations from LXX, (Cremer, 79, 438).
τό, = ποίμνη, which see [in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for עֵדֶר,] a flock, prop., of sheep. Metaphorical, of Christians: τ. θεοῦ, ib..

(ὀργή), [in LXX chiefly for חָרָה, also for קָצַף,] to make angry, provoke to anger; in cl. most frequently in pass., and so always in NT, to be provoked to anger, be angry: absol., " (LXX), with dative, before ἐπί, with dative.
(δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, עָרִיץ, בַּיִת,] a prince, ruler, potentate: of God (Sir.46:5, 16, 2Ma.15:3), of a high official, (Cremer, 221).

τ [in LXX for כִּכָּר;] 1. a balance (Hom.). 2. that which is weighed, a talent; (a) a talent in weight (in Horn. always of gold); (b) a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight: ff.

to anoint; [in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁח of consecration to a sacred office: priest, prophet, king, of things,]. In NT, metaphorically, of God's anointing, (a) Christ: with inf., (LXX); with dupl. accusative, (LXX); πνεύματι ἁγίῳ, (b) Christians. SYN: see: ἀλείφω

[in LXX for בַּת, חָצֵר, עִיר,] a village or country town, prop, as opposite to a walled city: πόλεις καὶ κ., with the name added, Βηθλεέμ, Βηθανΐα, with the name of the district, τὰς κ. Καισαρίας, Σαμαρειτῶν

1. to place side by side, draw up in battle-order, (Herdotus Historicus),—;Mid. to draw up one's men in battle-order, (Xenophon Historicus); so of ships, (Thucydides):—;Mid. and Pass. to be drawn up along, παρατετάχατο παρὰ τὴν ἀκτήν (Herdotus Historicus); ἑκατέρωθεν παρατεταγμένοι (Thucydides); so…

τό [in LXX chiefly for מִדָּה, also for אֵיפָה,] 1. that which is used for measuring, a measure; (a) a vessel: fig., ἐκ μ., by measure, (b) a rod or rule: figuratively. 2. That which is measured, measure: with genitive of thing(s).

[in LXX chiefly for עֵת and in Da for שָׁעָה;] 1. any time or period fixed by nature, esp. a season. 2. A part of the day, and esp. a twelfth part of day or night, an hour: accus. in ans. to "when"? (M, Pr., 63, 215; Bl., §34, 8), accusative of duration, 26, inexactly, πρὸς ὥραν, for a season, for a time, πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας…

[in LXX chiefly for נָאַם, also for אָמַר; frequently in 2-4 Mac;] to declare, say: frequently in quoting the words of another, interjected into the recorded words (cl.), φησί, impersonal, (WH, mg., φασίν), joined with syn. verb, ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ἔφη, before -πρός, with accusative of thing(s), accusative and inf., before ὅτι
κατ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for יָרַד hi.;] to bring down: with accusative of person(s), id. before εἰς, as nautical term, to bring to land: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, pass., before εἰς.

(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אָמַן;] I. Pass., to be trusted or believed; 1. of persons, trusty, faithful: of God, before ἐν, ἐπί, with accusative, ἄχρι θανάτου, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ π., id. καὶ ἀληθινός. 2. Of things, trustworthy, reliable, sure. II. Act., believing, trusting, relying: pl., opposite to ἄπιστος, π. εἰς θεόν, π. ποιεῖν, III Jn 5.
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פֶּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע,] ungodliness, impiety: ἔργα ἀσεβείας, ungodly deeds, Ju 15; ἐπιθυηίαι τ. ἀσεβειῶν, desires for ungodly things or deeds, Ju 18.
( ἀσθενής) [in LXX chiefly for כָּשַׁל;] to be weak, feeble: with dative, πίστει (Cremer, 527), same implied, εἰς. Specif., of bodily debility, to be sick: οἱ ἀσθενοῦντες, the sick.

Hellenistic form of cl. ἀγάλλω, to glorify, mid. -ομαι, to exult in; [in LXX (most frequently in Pss.) chiefly for גיל, רנן pi.;] to exult, rejoice greatly: before ἐπί, with dative, with dative mod.. Mid., with same sense: before ἵνα, ἐν, (Cremer, 590).
εὐ-οδόω, -ῶ (ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for צָלַח hi.;] to help on one's way. Pass., to have a prosperous journey; metaphorically, to prosper, be prospered, be successful.
(= καθ᾽ ὅ τι), adv., [in LXX: (אֲשֶׁר), Tob.1:12, Jdth.2:13,] 1. in dl., according as, just as (Ex, l.with). 2. In late Gk. = διότι (Tob, l.with), because.
[in LXX for יָגוֹן, מַר, (26 words in all);] pain, distress, of body or mind.

[in LXX for קוּם,] trans.; 1. to awaken, arouse from sleep: metaphorically, of spiritual awakening, (pass.), pass., to be aroused, wake up: ἀπὸ τ. ὕπνου. 2. Freq. in NT, to raise from the dead: νεκρούς, ἐκ νεκρῶν, pass., rise from death: ἀπὸ τ. νεκρῶν, 3. In late Gk., (a) to raise, from sitting, lying, sickness; mid. and pass.…

[in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi.;] 1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to. 2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: with dative of person(s), with accusative of thing(s), with accusative and inf., pass..
(ἔρημος), [in LXX for חָרַב hi., שָׁמֵם ni.,] to desolate, lay waste.
(πονηρός), [in LXX chiefly for רַע;] iniquity, wickedness: pl., κακία καὶ π.. SYN.: see: κακία.
(Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω), [in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר;] to sing, (a) intrans., with dative, of praise to God: (b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν.

όν [in LXX: (מִקְדָּשׁ); τό ἱ, (בַּיִת), (עֲזָרָה); very frequently in I -4 Mac;] 1. in Hom., marvellous, mighty, divine. 2. (Also in Hom, and later cl.) consecrated to the deity, sacred: pl., ἱ. γράμματα. 3. As subst., (a) (so in Hom.), τὰ ἱ., sacrifices, sacred rites, sacred things: (b) later, τὸ ἱ.., a consecrated or sacred place…

[in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁר;] 1. straight, direct: τρίβοι, " (LXX); εἰς εὐθειας, (sc. ὁδούς), εὐ. ὐδός, figuratively, as (Proper name) of a street. 2. In moral sense, straightforward, right: καρδία. εὐθύς, adv., [in LXX (more frequently than εὐθέως) chiefly for יָשַׁר;] = εὐθέως, straightway, directly: times in Mk.
adv., [in LXX chiefly for לֵךְ, לֵכָה;] 1. of place; (a) hither, with verbs of motion; (b) (in cl. chiefly poët.) as an imperat., here! come!: " (LXX), 34 (LXX). 2. Of time, hitherto, now.
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ (ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ,] a going out, departure: of death.
(ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, frequently in Le;] a joint: (Lft., in l).

[in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי,] low-lying; metaphorically, (a) lowly, of low degree, brought low: οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, τ. ταπεινοῖς, (b) lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually in a slighting sense, in NT in an honourable sense: before τ. καρδίᾳ, opposite to ὑπερήφανος, " (LXX).

(Rec. βαάλ), ὁ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, lord), Baal: (LXX). The fem. art. here agrees with the usage of LXX, where, following a similar Hebrew practice (בֹּשֶׁת for בַּעַל), αἰσχύνη appears to have been substituted in reading for the written Βάαλ, and to account for the frequently use of the fem. art. bef. Β. The usage, however…

(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט;] a judge: τ. ἀδικίας, with gem of thing(s) (obj.), (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, of a Roman procurator, of God, Christ, of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, in the OT sense, of a ruler in Israel. SYN.: δικάστης, q.v

[in LXX chiefly for יָמִים;] 1. period or course of life, life. 2. living, livelihood, means. SYN.: ζωή, is life intensive, "vita quâ, vivimus," the vital principle; βίος, life extensive, "vita quam vivimus," (1) the period of life, (2) the means by which it is sustained. Hence, in cl., ζ.…

ἐπι-βάλλω [in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית,] 1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, with dative (Polyb.), with inf., τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ. 2. Intrans.…

[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן,] primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order: with dative (accusative) and inf., (διατ-, WH); ἑαυτούς, pass., (T [WH], R, txt., om.), ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, mid.…

ἐξ-ίστημι (also in Hellenistic -ιστάνω, Act), [in LXX for H2730, (29 words in all);], 1. causal in Pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaphorically, ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., to confound, amaze: with accusative of person(s). 2. Intr. in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf.…
[in LXX chiefly for אַלְמָנָה;] a widow: (Rec., R, mg.), γυνὴ χ., of one of an ordo viduarum, metaphorically, of a city forsaken.
τό [in LXX for מָגֵן, צִנָּה,] 1. a tool, implement, instrument: ὅπλα ἀδικίας. 2. Freq., in pl., arms, weapons: metaphorically, τ. φωτός, τ. δικαιοσύνης.
κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon. (κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi.;] to curse: with accusative, opposite to εὐλογέω, pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse.

ἀνα-παύω, [in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן,] to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: Phm 20; pass., Phm 7. Mid., to take rest, enjoy rest: as in Heb. ofIs (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ..

1. a drink-offering, i. e. the wine poured out to the gods before drinking, Lat. libatio, (Hesiod); σπονδὰς θεοῖς λείβειν, σπένδειν (Aeschulus Tragicus) 2. in plural, σπονδαί was a solemn treaty or truce, (because solemn drink-offerings were made on concluding them); σπονδαὶ ἄκρητοι the truce made by pouring unmixed wine…
τό (ὀχυρόω, to fortify, make firm), [in LXX for מִבְצָר,] a stronghold, fortress; in LXX and NT, also metaphorically of that in which confidence is placed.
(on accusative pl., -εῖς, ν. BI., § 8, 2; Thack., Gr., 148), ὁ (ἵππος), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָשׁ;] a horseman.
(κράτος), (in cl. poët, form of κρατερός), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק and cognates;] strong, mighty.
δια-σπείρω [frequently in LXX for פּוּץ,] to scatter abroad, disperse.

ἐπ-ερωτάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ,] 1. to in­quire of, consult, question: with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative, with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, εἰ, ἐ. θεόν, (LXX). 2. In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: with accusative of person(s) and inf.

[in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi., also for לָבַשׁ, עָטָה,] to throw around or over, put on or over; (a) of siege or defen­sive works: χάρακά σοι, (WH, mg.; παρεμβ-, WH, txt.); (b) of clothing, to put on, wrap about, clothe with: with accusative of thing(s), with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (not cl.; Bl., § 34, 4), pf…
(in cl. more frequently τὸ ζυγόν), -οῦ, ὁ (ζεύγνυμι), [in LXX for עֹל, מֹאזֵן,] 1. a yoke; metaphorically, of bondage or submission to authority. 2. a balance.
[in LXX for גֶּפֶן;] vine: figuratively, of Christ, of his enemies.
[in LXX for רוּחַ;] wind: pl., Ju 12; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, hence the four quarters of the heavens, metaphorically, of variable teaching, Eph 414. SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή.
־εως, ἡ (βαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for אֶדֶן;] 1. a step. 2. Hence, a foot (Plat.; Wis.13:18).

ἐφ-ίστημι [in LXX for נָצַב ni., שִׁית, נָתַן,] 1. causal in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to set upon or by, set up. 2. Intrans. in mid, and in pf. and 2 aor. act.; (a) to stand upon; (b) to be set over; (with) to stand by, be present, be at hand, come on or upon: with dative pars., with dative bc., before έπί, with accusative, of rain…

ἀνθ-ίοτημι (ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עָמַד, יָצַב,] 1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against. 2. In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: with dative.

(θεωρός, a spectator, θεάομαι) [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה, חָזָה;] (present and imperfect only, exc. (fut.), (aor.); El., § 24); 1. (cl.), to look at, gaze, behold: absol., before πῶς, ποῦ, with accusative of person(s), id. with ptcp., with accusative of thing(s), id. with ptcp., before ὅτι. 2. In popular lang.…
[in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת,] 1. trans., (a) to cause to cease, restrain: (b) to cause to rest. 2. Intrans., to rest: before ἀτό, (LXX).
[in LXX for בֶּטֶן, ἐν γ. ἔχειν for הרה, ἐν γ. λαμβάνειν for חרה;] 1. the belly: metaphorically, a glutton. 2. the womb: ἐν γ. ἔχειν, to be with child, " (LXX), εν γ. συλλαμβ., to conceive.
(κατέχω), [in LXX nearly always for אֲחֻזָּה] 1. a holding back. 2. LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession.
δια-σώζω [in LXX for מָלַט, יָשַׁע,] to bring safely through a danger: before πρός. Pass., to come safe through: ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, δι᾽ ὕδατος, of sickness, to recover.
[in LXX chiefly for אָבַל;] to mourn (for), lament; (a) intrans.: (5); π. καὶ κλαίειν, before ἐπί, with accusative, (b) trans., with accusative. SYN.: see: θρηνέω
[in LXX chiefly for בְּתוּלָה, (15), also for נַעַר, נַעֲרָה, and for עַלְמָה,] a maiden, virgin: (LXX), ff, masc., of chaste persons (CIG, 8784 b).
indecl. (Heb. מִדְיָן), Midian; 1. son of Abraham. 2. An Arabian tribe. 3. γῆ Μ. (Heb. מִדְיָן אֶרֶץ), the land of Midian.
[in LXX chiefly for מֹתֶן; also for חָלַץ,] the loin: metaphorically, περιζώννυσθαι (ἀναζ-) τ. ὀσφύας, regarded, as by the Hebrews, as the seat of generative power, metaphorically, καρπὸς τ. ὀσφύος
(τρίβω), [in LXX for מְסִלָּה, נָתִיב,] a beaten track, a path: " (LXX).

(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for ידע hi.;] 1. as most commonly in cl., to come to know, discover, know. 2. to make known: with accusative, with accusative of thing(s) da.t. of person(s), " (LXX), with dative, before ὅτι, before τί, περί. Pass., 10.

interj. of grief or denunciation, [in LXX for הוֹי,] alas! woe! most frequently with dative of person(s), Ju 11, with vocat. (nom.), with accusative, before ἐκ, with dative before ἀπό. As subst., ἡ οὐ., pl., οὐ., οὐ., οὐ.

(bef. consonants, exc., μέχρι Ἰωάνου) and μέχρις 1. as prep., with genitive, as far as, even to, until; (a) of place: (b) of time: (with) of measure or degree. 2. As conjunct. (as long as), until: μ. οὗ.
[in LXX for עֵזֶר,] help: pl., helps, "frapping," a technical nautical term (MM, Exp., x; DB, ext., 367).

τό (πάιτχω), [in LXX: (אֵבֶל), and very frequently in *;] like πάθημα; 1. that which befalls one, that which one suffers 2. a passive emotion or affection, a passion, passionate desire; in NT always in bad sense: π. ἀτιμίας, π. ἐπιθυμίας. SYN.: π. = πάθημα, exc. that πάθημα is the more concrete and particular. In NT usage, π…
[in LXX chiefly for סֹלֶת;] fine wheaten flour.

(ἄδικος), [in LXX for עשׁק, עוה,] 1. intrans., to be ἄδικος, do wrong, act wickedly or criminally: to do hurt. 2. Trans. (a) to do some wrong: ὃ ἠδίκησεν, to wrong some one, Phm 18, pass., mid., (b) to injure, hurt.
[in LXX chiefly for עֶבֶד;] an attendant, servant: (LXX) SYN.: see: διάκονος
(δόξα [in LXX for כָּבַד,] 1. held in honour, of high repute. 2. glorious, splendid: of deeds, τά ἔ., of clothing. Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία.
(αἰνέω), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹדָה, תְּהִלָּה;] praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως (, זֶבַח תּוֹדָה).

(πότος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁקָה hi.;] to give to drink: with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative, fig., γάλα, ἐκ τ. οἴνου; of plants, to water, figuratively, Metaphorical, of the Spirit.

[in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi., also for בָּהַל pi., hi.,] 1. most frequently intrans., to hasten: with inf. (as frequently in cl.), ptcp. with indic., with imperat., σπεῦσον κ. ἔξελθε, 2. Trans., with accusative; (a) to hasten, urge on, accelerate (as Hom., Od., xix, 137; Eur., Med., 152; Sir.33:8 (Sir.36:8): R, mg.…
[in LXX for צְוָחָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה,] crying, outcry, clamour.

[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל;] 1. to ask, question (cl.): absol., with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, with dupl. accusative, (M, Pr., 66„); with accusative of person(s), before περί. 2. In late Gk., = αἰτέω, to ask, request: with accusative of person(s), before imperat., λέγων, before ἵνα (M, Pr., 208), ὅπως, with inf.…

(collat. form of poët. μάκαρ, in Hom., Hes., chiefly of the gods and the departed), [in LXX for אֹשֶׁר;] blessed, happy (DCG, i, 177, 213): θεός (δυνάστης), ἐλπίς, esp. in congratulations, usually with the omission of the copula (M, Pr., 180; B1., § 30, 3), μ. ὁ, ff., ff., before ptcp., ὅς, ὅτι, ἐάν, compar., μ.... μᾶλλον, -ώτερος…
τό [in LXX frequently for דְּבַשׁ; for נֹפֶת,] honey: ἄγριον.

ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον (ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים;] over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, ἐξ ἐναντίας, with genitive. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: ὁ ἐξ ἐ.. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: (ἔναντι, T), (LXX).

(τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, often meaning, as, to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον, or do away with what has been laid down]. 1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην, ἐντολήν, νόμον.; πίστιν. 2. to nullify, make void. 3. to reject: (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk…
indecl., [in LXX for צָבָא, chiefly in Isaiah;] Sabaoth, i.e. hosts or armies: (LXX), Ja 54.

(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת;] 1. a seeking to know, inquiry, investigation. 2. knowledge, in NT, specially of the kn. of spiritual truth: absol., (Lft., Notes, 147), with genitive obj., σωτηρίας, τ. δόξης τ. θεοῦ, τ. θεοῦ, Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, with genitive subjc., θεοῦ, λόγος γνώσεως, ψευδωνύμου γνώσεως. SYN.: σοφία, φρόνησις.
ἀπ-ωθέω, -ῶ [in LXX for זָנַח, מָאַס,] to thrust away. Mid., to thrust away from oneself, refuse, reject: with accusative of person(s).

[in LXX for אוֹר hi., רָאָה ni.,] I. Act., 1. to bring to light, cause to appear (so most frequently in cl.). 2. Absol., to give light, shine. II. Pass., to come to light, appear, be manifest: " (LXX); opposite to ἀφανίζεσθαι, with dative of person(s), with nom. pred., id. with dative of person(s), impers., of the mind and judgment…
(κύριος), [in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁל;] to be lord or master of, to rule (over): C. genitive obj., absol., metaphorically, ὁ θάνατος, ἡ ἁμαρτία, ὁ νόμος.

παρ-οικέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for גּוּר, also for יָשַׁב, שָׁכַן] in cl., to dwell beside (with accusative), among (with dative) or near by (absol.). In late writers, to dwell in a place as a πάροικος or stranger.
before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time former, prior, before, former, prior, before, formerly
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂכָר;] 1. prop., wages, hire: Ju 11; μ. ἀδικίας. 2. Generally, reward: esp. of divine rewards, ἔχειν μ..
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi., עָנָה pi.;] 1. to ill-treat, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s). 2. (not in cl.), to embitter
[in LXX: (כִּבְשָׁן, כּוּר), Dan LXX TH ff. (אַתּוּן);] a furnace.
[in LXX for רָפָא, exc. (חָבַשׁ);] to heal: with accusative of person(s), pass., id. before ἀπό᾽, figuratively, of spiritual healing, " (LXX); pass.. SYN.: θεραπεύω, q.v

[in LXX for סוּר, עָבַר, פָּרַר, שָׂטָה,] 1. in Hom. (twice), to go by the side of, stand beside. 2. In Æsch., Herod., Thuc., to go past or pass over, chiefly metaphorically, to overstep, violate, transgress: τ. παράδοσιν, τ. ἐντολήν, before ἀπό, to turn aside, fall away.
(Heb. בִּלְעָם), as in LXX (FlJ has ὁ βάλαμος); Balaam: Ju 11.
an oak-coppice; and, generally, a coppice, wood, only in plural δρυμά, (Homer); δρυμός in (Sophocles Tragicus)
(φρονέω), [in LXX for בִּינָה, תָּבוּן, חׇכְמָה,] understanding, practical wisdom, prudence. SYN.: see: σοφία, and cf. Lft., Notes, 317
ή (πήγνυμι), [in LXX for פַּח, מוֹקֵשׁ, רֶשֶׁת,] poët. and late for πάγη, a trap, snare; metaphorically (as also in cl.): " (LXX).

depon. mid., [in LXX chiefly for לקח;] to receive, accept; 1. with accusative of thing(s), of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, id. in different sense, ποτήριον, παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, ἐπιστολάς, τ. βασιλείαν τ. Θεοῦ, λογία ζῶντα, εὐαγγέλιον, τ. χάριν τ. Θεοῦ, metaphorically, of mental acceptance…

adv. [in LXX, εὖ γίγνεσθαι, εὖ ποιεῖν (יָטַב);] well: εὖ γιν., (LXX); εὖ ποιεῖν, with dative, to do good, εὖ πράσστειν, to fare well, in replies (= εὖγε), good! well done! (εὖγε, WH, txt.). εὖ-γε, adv., in replies, well! good! well done!.

related to οὐδείς as μή to οὐ, no, none, no one; neut., nothing: with genitive, neut. accusative, μηδέν, adverbially, in no respect, as accusative obj. after verb, βλάπτειν, ὠφελεῖσθαι, ὑστερεῖν, μεριμνᾶν, in double negation, strengthening the denial, μηκέτι μ., μὴ... μηδέν (μηδένα, μηδεμίαν), μηθείς, see. μηδείς

[in LXX chiefly for יָכַח hi.;] 1. in Hom., to treat with contempt. 2. to convict: with accusative, (RV, show him his fault), before περί, Ju 15; pass.. 3. to reprove, re­buke: pass., before περί, ὑπό, (LXX). 4. to expose: pass., (RV reprove, mg. convict). SYN.: ἐπιτιμῶ, expressing simply rebuke, which may be un­deserved or ineffectual…
also written σάκος, -ου, ὁ, 1. a coarse cloth, sackcloth, usually made of hair. 2. Anything made of sackcloth; (a) a sack; (b) a garment of sackcloth, expressive of mourning or penitence.
1. like ἐχυρός, firm, lasting, stout, (Hesiod) 2. of places, strong, secure, (Euripides): especially of a stronghold or position, strong, tenable, (Xenophon Historicus) 3. adverb -ρῶς, (Euripides)

ἀνα-γινώσκω (Attic ἀναγιγν-), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא;] 1. to know certainly, know again, recognize. 2. Of written characters, to read: with accusative of thing(s), with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, before ἐν, (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), before ὅτι, τί ἐποίησε, pass.; of reading aloud, (M, Th., in l).
[in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms;] 1. wantonness, insolence. 2. = ὕβρισμα, an act of wanton violence, an outrage, injury: metaphorically, of a loss by sea (find.).
(of Oriental origin), [in LXX chiefly for כְּלִמָּה,אָשָׁם, and frequently in 4Mac;] 1. prop., touchstone, a dark stone used in testing metals. 2. examination by torture. 3. torment, torture.
ἐπι-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, frequently in Mac;] 1. a message. 2. a letter, an epistle: pl., ἐ. σνστατικαί.

ἀνά-παυσις, -εως, ή (ἀνάπαύω) [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ and its derivatives, שַׁבָּת and its cognates (Ex, Le);] cessation, rest, refreshment. SYN.: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavour­able conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ.…

[in LXX chiefly for בָּרָא, also for קָנָה, יָצַר, Wis.2:23, Sir.1:4, 9 (and freq.), I, a1.;] 1. in cl., to people or found a region or city (1Es, l.with). 2. In LXX and NT, of God, to create: ὁ κτίσας, (WH, R, mg.), of the divine operation on the soul.
(= δύσις, δύνω), [in LXX for בּוֹא, עֲרָבָה,] mostly in pl., opposite to ἀνατολαί; 1. a setting, as of the sun. 2. the quarter of sunset, the west: anarth..
δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι [in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi.;] to set out in detail, recount, describe: absol., with accusative of thing(s), with dative of person(s), before πῶς, ἅ εἶδον, ὅσα ἐποίησε, -αν.
adv., [in LXX for מָחָר;] to-morrow: ἡ αὔ., ἐπὶ τὴν αὔ., τὸ (WH om.) τῆς.
(θαῦμα), [in LXX chiefly for פָּלָא ni. (n. pl. = פָּלָא;) wonderful; n. pl., wonders.

also (in cl. after Thuc.) -η, -ον, [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן, מָכוֹן;] prepared, ready; (a) of things: ἔρχεσθε ὅτι ἤδη ἕτοιμά ἐστιν (Field, Notes, 67), ὁ καιρός, (b) of persons: before πρός, with inf., τοῦ, with inf., ἐν ἑ. ἔχω (MM, Exp., xiv), with inf..

1. acquaintance with a matter, skill, experience, as in archery, (Sophocles Tragicus); in war, (Thucydides), 2. generally, knowledge, (Sophocles Tragicus): especially scientific knowledge, science, (Plato Philosophus)

[in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַשׁ;] a root: ἐκ ῥιζῶν, ῥ. ἔχειν, id. before ἐν ἑαυτῷ, figuratively. Metaphorical (as in various senses in cl.), of cause, origin, source, (a) of things, ῥ. πάντων τ. κακῶν (Eur.), (b) of persons: of ancestors, ῥ. πικρίας. Of that which springs from a root, a shoot; metaphorically, of offspring, (LXX).
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹף;] in trag., Ion. and late writers, winged, flying; as subst., τὸ π., a winged fowl, a bird: pl..
[in LXX chiefly for עזר;] 1. (poët. -όος), hasting to the war-cry (Hom.). 2. helping, auxiliary; as subst. (Hdt.), a helper: (LXX).
(θυμός) [in LXX (chiefly in pass.) for חָרָה, אַף חָרָה hith.,] (no act. in Attic.); pass. (and mid.), to be wroth or very angry.
[in LXX for שְׂמֹאול;] left, on the left: ὅπλα, ἡ ἀ.. (sc. χείρ), ἐξ ἀριστερῶν, on the left.

[in LXX chiefly for רוּץ;] to run: with inf., before ἐπί, [T [WH] R, mg., om.]; εἰς, ptcp., δραμών, with indic.. Metaphorical, from runners in a race, of swiftness or of effort to attain an end: τ. ἀγῶνα, ὁ λόγος τ. κυρίου, ἕως τάχους δραμεῖται ὁ λ. αὐτοῦ), δράμω, obsol., to run, see: τρέχω

adv., [in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב;] near; 1. of place: as prep. with genitive (M, Pr., 99), with dative, superl., ἔγγιστα, WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, ἐ. γίνεσθαι, ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, (LXX). 2. Of time: ὁ κύριος ἐ., before ἐπὶ θύραις, compar., ἐγγύτερον (neut. of adj. -ος, used adverbially), as prep. with genitive…
[in LXX chiefly for מַרְאֶה;] 1. the act of seeing, the sense of sight. 2. face, countenance. 3. appear­ance: κατ᾽ ὄ. κρίνειν.

1. to go slowly, to walk, Lat. ambulare, (Homeric Hymns): to go, march, of horsemen, (Xenophon Historicus): to go by land, (Demosthenes Orator):—;with accusative cognate, βάδον, ὁδὸν β. (Aristophanes Comicus) 2. generally, ἐπ᾽ οἰκίας βαδ. to enter houses, (Demosthenes Orator): to proceed (in argument), (Demosthenes Orator):—;of things…
adv., [in LXX for רָחוֹק hi., רָחַק,] a long way, far: before ἀπό, id. metaphorically, οἱ εἰς μ., metaphorically, οἱ ποτὲ ὄντες μ. (opposite to ἐγγύς), οἱ μ..
[in LXX chiefly for יָדַע;] to know, know of, understand: with accusative of person(s), with ptcp., with accusative of thing(s), Ju 10; before περί, ὅτι, ὡς, πῶς, ποῦ. SYN: γινώσκω, οἶδα
1. inspection, visitation, (Xenophon Historicus) 2. investigation, inquiry, (Xenophon Historicus)
[in LXX chiefly for תָּקַע;] to sound a trumpet: ff.; metaphorically. Impers., the trumpet sounds.
1. a placing in line of battle, ἐκ παρατάξεως in regular battle, (Thucydides), 2. of marshalling a political party, arrangement, (Aeschines Orator) from παρατάσσω

εὐ-σέβεια, -ας, ἡ, [in LXX: (יִרְאָה), (aliter in Heb.), (יְהוָֹה יִרְאָה), I, Wis.10:12, Sir.49:3, and very frequently in 4Mac;] 1. piety, reverence (towards parents and others). 2. piety towards God, godliness: τὸ τῆς εὐ. μυστήριον, ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ. διδασκαλία, ἡ ἀλήθεια ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ., μόρφωσις εὐσεβείας, pl..

(γίγνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹלֵדֹת;] 1. origin, lineage: βίβλος γενέσεως (as in a). 2. birth: (Rec. γέννησις); πρόσωπον τῆς γ., face of his birth ("what God made him to be," Hort., in l.), ὁ τροχὸς τῆς γ., the wheel (course) of birth or creation ("the wheel of man's nature according to its original Divine purpose," Hort).
τό [in LXX chiefly for בְּאֵר;] a well: φ. τῆς ἀβύσσου.

(σκέλλω, to dry), [in LXX chiefly for קָשָׁה;] hard to the touch, rough, harsh, (opposite to μαλακός); metaphorically, in various uses; (a) of men, hard, stern, severe: (b) of things, hard, rough, violent: σκληρόν σοι (ἐστι), λόγος, ἄνεμος, σκληρὰ λαλεῖν, Ju 15. SYN.: αὐστηρός, q.v
συν-αντάω, -ῶ [in LXX for פָּגַע, פָּגַשׁ, קָרָא, קָרָה,] to meet with: with dative of person(s). Metaphorical, of events, to happen, befall.
1. power, lordship, sovereignty, (Sophocles Tragicus), 2. an oligarchy, (Thucydides) from δῦναστεύω
[in LXX chiefly for סָכַךְ;] to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell: before ἐν, ὑπό, with accusative, ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, (LXX).

[in LXX for הָמוֹן (chiefly in Da TH), קָהָל,חַיִל,] 1. a moving crowd or multitude of persons, a throng: pl., and freq.; ὄ. ἱκανός, τοσοῦτος, οὐ μετ᾽ ὄχλου, ἄτερ ὄχλου, πᾶς ὁ ὄ., ὄ. πολύς, ὁ πολὺς ὄ. (ὄ. π.), the populace, the common people, (Swete, in l.; Field, Notes, 37), (Westc, in l.). 2., the populace, the common people, b…

1. acting contrary to law, lawless, (Euripides) 2. of things, contrary to law, unlawful, (Aristophanes Comicus),—;adverb, παρανόμως, illegally, (Thucydides) 3. in attic law, παράνομα γράφειν, εἰπεῖν to propose an illegal measure, (Demosthenes Orator); παρανόμων γράφεσθαί τινα to indict one for proposing such a measure…

(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה;] 1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: with genitive obj., with prep., ἐν, εἰς, πρός, Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative; ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., ὁ ἐκ π., διὰ (τῆς) π.. By meton., objectively…
(late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק;] to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: πνεύματι, δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος.

τό (πέρα, beyond), [in LXX chiefly for קֵץ, קָצָה and cognate forms;] an end, limit, boundary; (a) of space: chiefly in pl., τὰ π. τ. γῆς, τ. οἰκουμένης, (LXX); (b) (opposite to ἀρχή) the end: with genitive, ἀντιλογίας.

[in LXX chiefly for זָרַע;] to sow (seed): absol., with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς, ἐν, ἐπί, with genitive, ἐπί, with accusative, παρά, with accusative. Metaphorical: in proverbial sayings, in interpretation of parables
[in LXX for חֲמִישִׁי and cognate forms;] fifth.

[in LXX chiefly for צֶלֶם;] an image, likeness: opposite to σκιά, of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, 1 Co; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ; εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ.
